description:
Compute a cryptographic hash of a string.

Returns: Hex digest of the input using the requested algorithm.
Example input: {"text":"hello world","algorithm":"sha256"}
On error, includes hint: `algorithm` must be one of: md5, sha1, sha256, sha384, sha512.

algorithm.description: md5, sha1, sha256, sha384, or sha512

name: hash
title: Hash text
